schema.description: Response after successfully installing a plugin

plugin.description: InstalledPlugin contains the full installation record.

clients.description: Clients is the list of client identifiers the plugin is installed for.

components.description:
Components is the inventory of component types declared by the plugin
(e.g. {"commands": 3, "skills": 2}). Extracted from the OCI artifact.
components.title: github_com_stacklok_toolhive_pkg_plugins.ComponentInventory

dependencies.description: Dependencies is the list of external plugin dependencies.

digest.description: Digest is the OCI digest for upgrade detection.

reference.description: Reference is the OCI reference for the dependency.

digest.description: Digest is the OCI digest (sha256:...) for upgrade detection.

installed_at.description: InstalledAt is the timestamp when the plugin was installed.

managed.description:
Managed indicates this install is tracked in the project's
toolhive.lock.yaml plugins: key. Only ever true for project-scoped
installs. No omitempty: false is an observable state (unmanaged),
not an absence.

author.description: Author is the plugin author or maintainer.

description.description: Description is a human-readable description of the plugin.

keywords.description: Keywords is a list of keywords for categorization/search.

license.description: License is the SPDX license identifier for the plugin.

name.description: Name is the unique name of the plugin (kebab-case).

version.description: Version is the semantic version of the plugin.

project_root.description: ProjectRoot is the project root path for project-scoped plugins. Empty for user-scoped.

reference.description: Reference is the full OCI reference (e.g. ghcr.io/org/plugin:v1).

signature.description: Signature is the optional signing signature for the plugin artifact.

status.description: Status is the current installation status.
status.title: github_com_stacklok_toolhive_pkg_plugins.InstallStatus

tag.description: Tag is the OCI tag (e.g. v1.0.0).

plugin.title: github_com_stacklok_toolhive_pkg_plugins.InstalledPlugin

provenance.description:
Provenance is the signer identity the project's lock file records
for this skill, when project-scoped and lock-managed.

cert_issuer.description: CertIssuer is the OIDC issuer that authenticated the signer.

provisional.description:
Provisional marks provenance with a documented verification gap
(git signatures until transparency-log validation lands).

public_key.description:
PublicKey is the base64-encoded DER SPKI cosign public key a
key-pair-signed entry is pinned to. Set only when SignerIdentity and
CertIssuer are empty: the two anchors are mutually exclusive.

repository_ref.description:
RepositoryRef is the git ref the signing workflow ran on, from Fulcio
certificate extension 1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.14. Empty means
unconstrained, matching lock files written before the field existed.

repository_uri.description:
RepositoryURI is the source repository from the certificate
extensions, when present.

runner_environment.description:
RunnerEnvironment is the runner class the signing workflow executed in
(e.g. "github-hosted"), from Fulcio certificate extension
1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.11. Empty means unconstrained.

signer_identity.description:
SignerIdentity is the certificate subject identity (workflow path for
GitHub Actions certificates, SAN verbatim otherwise).

sigstore_url.description: SigstoreURL is the Sigstore instance the signature chains to.

provenance.title: github_com_stacklok_toolhive_pkg_plugins.ProvenanceInfo

unsigned.description: Whether the install was recorded as an explicit unsigned exception.

schema.title: pkg_api_v1.installPluginResponse

Location.description: URI of the installed plugin resource

403.description: Forbidden (signature verification or trust check failed)

404.description: Not Found (artifact not present in registry)
